policies.local_packages: The UI, agent SDK and wallet use approved local paths, package names, versions and Apache-2.0 licenses. Manifest and lock metadata agree.
policies.installed_packages: Nested dependencies use canonical node_modules paths with pinned versions and approved licenses.
policies.runtime_budget: Seven direct runtime dependencies: UI, wallet, agent SDK, Next, QRCode, React and React DOM.
policies.wallet_dependencies: The wallet owns signature verification, hashing, session authentication and its viem dependency. The web app declares viem for development.

wallet_license_disposition.name: @paxeer/wallet
wallet_license_disposition.disposition: The first-party wallet uses Apache-2.0 and remains private. Its identity, target path, version, license and dependency metadata agree between the manifest and lockfile.

coverage.webLocalLinkPolicy: Checks approved local metadata, rejects unknown links and invalid installed paths, and enforces the wallet license and private flag.
coverage.webDependencyBudget: Checks the finite runtime dependency budget, manifest and lock equality, pinned versions and approved licenses.
coverage.wallet_exchange: The SDK ABI builder, wallet provider, HTTP transport and approval consumer preserve exact requests, allowances, approvals and malformed-response rejection.
